recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast composition featuring four muscular figures in bodybuilding poses against a solid black background, topped with massive red slab-serif typography and secondary handwritten-style text.
coreVisualRelationships: Massive red header text dominates the top third of the frame.
Four muscular figures are arranged in a staggered horizontal line across the bottom two-thirds.
High-contrast lighting creates deep shadows and bright highlights on muscle definition.
The red color of the text is echoed in the swimwear of the figures.
coreInvariants: Extreme muscular definition with oily skin highlights
Primary color palette of red, black, and flesh tones

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four bodybuilders occupy the lower half; the central figure is lower and wider, while the flanking figures stand tall.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, heavy red slab-serif title at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the heavy title, drop to the diagonal script in the center, and settle on the rhythmic muscular forms at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space separates the text from the subjects, creating a theatrical stage effect.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation red against zero-value black; high-value highlights on skin tones.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to red, black, blue, and natural skin tones

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold slab serif and casual brush script
letterConstructionRules: Header: Massive weight, square serifs, minimal tracking.
Subtitle: Slanted, brush-stroke texture, irregular baseline.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'U' and 'N' in the header have extremely thick vertical strokes and thin horizontal connectors.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between a rigid, heavy geometric slab and a loose, organic slanted script.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Stymie Black or Rockwell Extra Bold
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif weight and square terminals.
Captures the casual, slanted, hand-written energy of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a group of four bodybuilders in classic 1970s poses (double bicep, side chest) against a pure black background. Use high-contrast studio lighting to emphasize muscle fiber and oily skin. Figures should wear simple red or blue trunks. Leave the top 40% of the image as empty black space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a massive, ultra-bold red slab-serif title at the very top. Below it, add two lines of red brush-script text tilted upwards at a 15-degree angle.

verificationChecks: Is the header text heavy enough to feel 'crushing'?
Is the background pure black with no environmental details?
Are the muscle highlights sharp and high-contrast?
Is the script text noticeably slanted?

adjustableVariables: Specific red hue (from crimson to bright scarlet)
mustRedesign: Avoid specific faces or likenesses of the original band members
Do not use the specific brand logos in the corners
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not overlap the heads of the figures.
Check that the red color is consistent between text and trunks.
Verify that the background is 100% black.
Confirm the slab serifs are perfectly horizontal/vertical.
recipe.reuseFormula: Heavy Slab Header + Slanted Brush Script + High-Contrast Muscular Figures + Solid Black Void
